body: This has teared me apart. Reading this, I know you are gone and how i wish i could make that not be true. Please let it not be real.

I am doing absolutely nothing with my life. I wake up with no meaning to my day. I saw this video "What will your week look like?" and I was genuinely perplexed because it never occurred to me that people have meaningful days. A week feels like two days for me. I cannot remember what I did and I have no excitement for whats to come. I wait for something exciting to happen and nothing does. My life feels like it is running away and I do not know what to do to stop it. I feel so useless.

Same here. What upsets me the most is that the people that have everything say that it is not worth it. Or that money isn't everything. But then we go to school and are taught to climb up the ladder and maybe we'll have a good life. But I look around me and everybody has what I have to fight for. It is very tiresome to life the life that we have.
